parsed.explanation: The quoted sentence omits both the overlay construction and the cut-count argument for the essential case B≠∅. Later sections merely invoke the refinement lemma, while the boundary remarks only assert properties of the same unexplained construction. The separately proved B=∅ case does not cover all subset pairs. Establishing L3.2 therefore requires a genuine all-n construction lemma showing paired cells, residual discrepancy, and at most q−1 actual cuts.
